title.zh: Michigan court orders Kalshi to keep blocking sports prediction markets
title.en: Michigan court orders Kalshi to keep blocking sports prediction markets

current_state.zh: A Michigan court ordered Kalshi to continue blocking sports prediction markets, converting a June temporary restraining order into an injunction with a $500,000-per-day fine for violations.
